playbackTemplateSpec.name: O-MicrotonalSampler
playbackTemplateSpec.creator: Ouaricon Audio
playbackTemplateSpec.description: Loads O-MicrotonalSampler with technique-keyswitch routing (Sul pont., Sul tasto, Senza vib., Con sord., Pizz., Harm., Mart., Trem., Flaut. → keyswitch notes C-1..A-1) and CC11-driven dynamics. Microtonal pitch deltas route via VST3 Note Expression (kTuningTypeID).
